import ipaddress, random, subprocess, pathlib, sys, os
BIN='/work/submit/planb64'
D=pathlib.Path('/work/planb-tests'); D.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
MASK=(1<<64)-1

def run(args, ok=True):
    p=subprocess.run(args,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
    if ok and (p.returncode or p.stderr or (args[1]=='build' and p.stdout)):
        raise AssertionError((args,p.returncode,p.stdout,p.stderr))
    if not ok and (p.returncode!=2 or p.stdout or not p.stderr.startswith(b'ERROR:')):
        raise AssertionError(('bad error',args,p.returncode,p.stdout,p.stderr))
    return p

def normalize(addr,l):
    k=int(ipaddress.IPv6Address(addr))>>64
    mask=0 if l==0 else MASK << (64-l)&MASK
    st=k&mask
    en=st|(~mask&MASK)
    return st,en

def pair_at(routes,k):
    best=None
    for st,en,h,l in routes:
        if st<=k<=en and (best is None or l>best[1]): best=(h,l)
    return best if best is not None else (-1,-1)

def reference(routes):
    keys={0}
    for st,en,h,l in routes:
        keys.add(st)
        if en!=MASK: keys.add(en+1)
    rows=[]; last=None
    for k in sorted(keys):
        pair=pair_at(routes,k)
        if pair!=last:
            rows.append((k,*pair));last=pair
    return rows

def check(routes, iteration):
    # Shuffle independent representations with host bits set.
    records=[]
    for st,en,h,l in routes:
        width=64-l
        lowrandom=random.getrandbits(64)
        high=st | (random.getrandbits(width) if width else 0)
        addr=ipaddress.IPv6Address((high<<64)|lowrandom)
        # Exercise expanded, compressed, and uppercase input.
        if iteration%3==0: text=addr.exploded.upper()
        elif iteration%3==1: text=addr.compressed
        else: text=addr.exploded
        records.append(f'{text}/{l:02d} {h:010d}')
    random.shuffle(records)
    fib=D/'fib'; image=D/'image'; trace=D/'trace'
    fib.write_text(('\n \t\r\n'.join(records) if records else '') + ('\n' if random.randrange(2) else ''))
    run([BIN,'build',str(fib),str(image)])
    got=[]
    lines=image.read_text().splitlines()
    assert lines[0]=='PLANB64 1' and int(lines[1])==len(lines)-2 and image.read_bytes().endswith(b'\n')
    for line in lines[2:]:
        a,b,c=line.split(' ');got.append((int(a,16),int(b),int(c)))
    exp=reference(routes)
    if got!=exp:
        print('records',records);print('got',got);print('exp',exp);raise AssertionError('image mismatch')
    keys={0,MASK}
    for _ in range(80):keys.add(random.getrandbits(64))
    for st,en,h,l in routes:
        keys.update((st,en,st-1 if st else 0,en+1 if en!=MASK else MASK))
        if st<=en:keys.add((st+en)//2)
    keys=sorted(keys)
    # Convert upper keys to valid addresses with random lower bits.
    trace.write_text(''.join(ipaddress.IPv6Address((k<<64)|random.getrandbits(64)).compressed+'\n' for k in keys))
    expected=''.join(f'{h} {l}\n' for h,l in (pair_at(routes,k) for k in keys))
    scalar=run([BIN,'lookup',str(image),str(trace),'scalar']).stdout.decode()
    assert scalar==expected,(scalar,expected)
    for batch in [1,2,3,7,16,255,256,'003','000001']:
        out=run([BIN,'lookup',str(image),str(trace),'batch',str(batch)]).stdout.decode()
        assert out==expected

special=[
 [],[(0,MASK,0,0)],[(0,MASK,4294967295,0)],
 [(0,MASK,7,0),(0,(1<<63)-1,7,1)],
 [(0,MASK,7,0),(0,(1<<63)-1,9,1),(1<<63,MASK,7,1)],
 [(0,0,0,64),(MASK,MASK,4294967295,64)],
 [(0,0,5,64),(1,1,5,64),(2,2,6,64)],
]
random.seed(82731)
for i,r in enumerate(special):check(r,i)
for it in range(150):
    n=random.randrange(0,35)
    routes=[];seen=set()
    for j in range(n):
        l=random.choice([0,1,2,3,4,7,8,15,16,31,32,47,48,63,64,random.randrange(65)])
        k=random.getrandbits(64)
        st,en=normalize(ipaddress.IPv6Address(k<<64),l)
        if (st,l) in seen:continue
        seen.add((st,l));routes.append((st,en,random.choice([0,1,7,4294967295,random.getrandbits(32)]),l))
    check(routes,it+len(special))
print('RANDOM_DIFFERENTIAL_OK')
